caption: The model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the evaluation Perplexity (PPL) as a function of activated parameter ratio. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio (%)” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick intervals of 25 units. The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL (%)” and represents a linear scale from approximately 11.1 to 14.3, with tick intervals of 0.5 units. A dashed red line at 13.0 represents the target value. There is a blue dashed line with a dotted style representing the Transformer model, starting at approximately 11.8 and reaching a maximum value of approximately 13.8 at around 75% activated parameters. A gray solid line with circular markers represents Only MoHD FFN, starting at approximately 11.4 and reaching a value of approximately 11.7 at 75% activated parameters. A blue solid line with circular markers represents Only MoHD ATTN, beginning at approximately 12.4 and reaching a value of approximately 12.8 at 75% activated parameters. A blue star-shaped marker line represents MoHD ATTN + MLP, starting at approximately 12.3 and reaching a value of approximately 13.1 at 75% activated parameters.
